buildspecOverride:
version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
phases:
  pre_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        test "$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION" = "b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7"
        test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64
        test "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" = 967807252336
        python3 scripts/validate-meri-build-isolation.py
        aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
        docker pull public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node@sha256:b20fe038d9592822dd534600a1ddf467e985178aa3fed60ec441a056c2cc45bd
        docker tag public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node@sha256:b20fe038d9592822dd534600a1ddf467e985178aa3fed60ec441a056c2cc45bd node:22.23.3-bookworm-slim
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        docker build --platform linux/arm64 --build-arg NODE_VERSION=22.23.3 --build-arg NODE_IMAGE=public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node@sha256:b20fe038d9592822dd534600a1ddf467e985178aa3fed60ec441a056c2cc45bd --build-arg NGINX_IMAGE=public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx-unprivileged@sha256:9de6da66da9ece40f08e7ba1d81011edfd1a496d9fa82a3f37ce4126b906b969 --build-arg GIT_SHA=b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 --build-arg CAPIRO_WEB_BUILD_SURFACE=vnext --label org.opencontainers.image.revision=b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web-vnext:b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 .
        test "$(docker image inspect 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web-vnext:b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 --format '{{.Architecture}}')" = arm64
  post_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web-vnext:b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 -c 'grep -rl "generates the Debrief from those notes" /usr/share/nginx/html/assets >/dev/null'
        docker push 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web-vnext:b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7
        aws ecr describe-images --region us-east-1 --repository-name capiro/dev/web-vnext --image-ids imageTag=b4af4110b3e9661c5249fa1cfa59d844eb2bf0e7 --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' --output text
